policy.identity: same task/agent/conversation; preserve explicit initial and latest follow-up directives even when context reads fail
policy.parent_scope: only authorized hierarchy references, same bearer/team, shared request deadline; no recursive project sweep
policy.resource_semantics: metadata only, contents not downloaded; unsafe URL credentials omitted; unavailable/incomplete marked
policy.format: bounded readable HTML and supported Tiptap JSON projections; valid Unicode; preserve explicit empty versus unavailable documents
policy.followup_reads: one canonical history read, no additional legacy thread-list read
policy.permissions: no caller permission widening or anonymous fallback
policy.comment_delivery_context: RIID-5900 preserves extended context from the existing server-key-verified monolith delivery evidence. Monolith reads same-task recent root comments (20 plus the immutable trigger, at most 21), same-team related work/meetings and bounded file/link metadata under the stored author's current scope. CP neither invents a user bearer nor performs anonymous follow-up reads. Only legacy evidence without extended context gets the trigger-only fallback; capture, body bounds, read audit and current viewer permission checks retain their existing paths.
policy.cli_read_quota: RIID-5900 allows 100 authenticated active-lease CLI read attempts per durable assignment ID, atomically across servers. Every request counts, including reused request IDs, denied targets and unavailable data; prompt capture, viewer read-history GET and local whoami do not count. Exhaustion returns 429 and storage failure returns 503 before any data read. Heartbeat, lease refresh, runtime run-label changes and snapshot recapture cannot reset the counter; a new follow-up assignment receives its own budget. Terminal transactions fence READ_QUOTA with the same first-terminal +24h TTL as payloads, including before the first CLI read. Active-lease validation precedes consumption so expired counter removal cannot revive a terminal execution.
policy.freshness: legacy provider JSON/HTML and component snapshots have unconfirmed freshness; never claim Yjs revision or cross-document atomicity; do not overwrite a nonempty component snapshot with unversioned provider HTML
policy.response_delivery: Single provider turn by default; answer-only requests need no repository or tool checks; latest directive overrides historical intent gates; fetch additional context only when needed.
policy.graphql_metadata_endpoint: When a separate GraphQL endpoint is configured, bundle provider JSON/HTML in one viewer-bearer GraphQL request and file/link metadata in another per authorized component; an optional resource root error cannot discard a document read. Keep workspace/detail REST checks and shared deadline. No cross-principal cache, anonymous fallback, attachment download, or replay on GraphQL denial. REST-only deployments retain bounded JSON/HTML fallback.
policy.failure_observation: Finite operation/outcome/source/duration trace fields distinguish missing/null/empty/invalid/budget/denied/unavailable; no upstream original, document identity, body, URL or token in observations.
policy.related_meeting_bodies: RIID-5900 captures only directly linked, same-team, undeleted meeting bodies under the requester bearer and shared deadline. At most 20 meetings, 4 concurrent reads, 8192 UTF-8 bytes per body; all stored bodies participate in the existing 256KiB snapshot bound and 24h terminal retention. Base/resources/prompt remain title-only; explicit meeting view alone serves and records a body read. Empty, denied, deleted and unavailable remain distinct. Viewer audit visibility rechecks current body access. Board, meeting comments and further linked-work reads remain unimplemented.
policy.viewer_reply_visibility: RIID-5900 viewer GET and SSE opt into current reply metadata only. First authorize the current workspace/task and read its bounded root comments with the viewer bearer. Roots with replyCount > 0 are deduplicated and capped at 200. One GraphQL alias batch invokes existing getCommentReplies under the same bearer/team; monolith binds every result to its requested current root parent. Request only id/status/updatedAt, retain at most 200 unique active replies, reject root ID collisions, and never use historical trigger or parent IDs as permission. Any HTTP/GraphQL error, null/missing expected alias, timeout, or response above the existing 1MiB bound hides the entire reply batch while retaining independently verified roots. Metadata-only replies have no body hash and cannot prove modified_since_read=false; only a strictly later comparable source timestamp proves true. Recheck every GET/event with no positive cache. Assignment snapshot/prompt scope is unchanged. Replies whose parents fall outside the existing bounded current root list remain unverified and hidden.
policy.bounded_read_scope: RIID-5900 typed read_scope v1 selects explicit structured work mentions, up to 5 direct related works across relation kinds, up to 5 direct meetings, direct parent/milestone/project and up to 10 children under the actual requester/team. Structured mention reason provenance accepts only mention, client_snapshot_mention, root_comment_mention and trigger_comment_mention. Selection happens once; selected targets are detail-only leaves and cannot expand another hop. Existing component/document/hierarchy fields and legacy snapshots remain readable. New scope consumption never falls back after authorization denial and does not imply external GitHub/Figma URL body fetching.
policy.assignment_content_pages: RIID-5900 captures selected work/meeting inspector metadata, body, board and comments pages while requester authorization exists, then serves only assignment-bound stored pages. Typed source/part/version/offset/status manifests authorize pages; both publication and read paths reject duplicate global manifest identities or resource-manifest disagreement; fixed body slots and non-null typed lists are validated, and metadata failures retain incomplete status; unselected targets, missing pages, changed versions and invented cursors fail closed. The original 256KiB snapshot plus at most ten 96KiB payload items is shared by comments and content; no total storage-budget increase. A scoped bundle publishes its snapshot and pages atomically. Upstream comment capture complete=false remains incomplete even when the supplied subset can be materialized. Overflow/deadline/part failure is explicitly incomplete with no cursor claiming uncaptured bytes; normal and multipage fixtures must reach actual completion before claiming full supported-field coverage. No requester token is retained, no live user-auth fallback occurs, and terminal TTL remains 24h. Capture uses exact incremental encoded-page/envelope/comma byte accounting rather than repeatedly serializing the full accumulated bundle; persisted publication independently repacks and verifies every block. Ten is a physical-item budget, not a source or logical-page count: pack multiple logical pages into each bounded block and bind block layout and digest in the snapshot manifest. The snapshot keeps selection summaries and captured part manifests; inspector/GitHub/Figma/link data lives in metadata payload parts, not duplicated into the bounded manifest. Resource identity includes component/backlog/intake/meeting kind plus ID; equal IDs from different tables remain separate and cursor lookup rechecks the original kind. Root resource team remains fixed; same-workspace leaves authorized by the producer preserve their actual team, and each captured continuation/evidence lookup binds selected kind/id to that team. Scoped repository metadata retains required false values; legacy prompt projection is separate. Actual lowercase GraphQL authentication/permission/not-found codes preserve denied/missing outcomes without leaking upstream messages. Fragmented JSON audit uses exact known-path leaf object byte ranges, matching source kind/id/version, and only records leaf sources intersecting delivered bytes. Resource-wide metadata/comments sources remain available for envelope-only fragments. Canonical serialized metadata versions avoid whitespace or HTML-escaping mismatches; source ranges are scanned once per JSON page. Scoped inline task/meeting/comments views reject a nonempty cursor with HTTP400 and direct the caller to context part; legacy comment paging is unchanged. Meeting pagination aggregate status and per-part completion may change across pages, while ID/team/details/labels and board version remain fixed.
policy.read_scope_audit: Every served content leaf records its source kind/id/part/version. Viewer HTTP/SSE visibility is rechecked with the current viewer and scoped source set; captured data never grants present access. Scoped prompts describe the root body as a preview and advertise the stored context index, source reads and opaque part continuation; a missing copied parent body is not labeled unavailable. Prompt records include only fields actually rendered. Copying an assignment for a same-task/workspace/requester agent mention copies its stored content pages and manifest as one bundle. Existing stored scoped snapshots select the typed current-viewer API even when new capture is disabled; only exact assignment/workspace/task/schema identity selects that API shape, never retained permission or source contents. HTTP history and SSE both carry the current viewer token and fail closed on snapshot identity or storage errors.
policy.read_scope_rollout: Source implementation and main merge are not rollout acceptance. Keep new scoped capture disabled until every control-plane terminal/capture writer understands content blocks and their lifecycle/24h retention; mixed old writers cannot be claimed safe and old schema downgrade is not an approved recovery path. No deployment or capability activation is authorized by these source changes.
policy.large_typed_parts: Large metadata/comments_page/board_page payloads use the four fixed kind-specific body roots with a normalized typed selector. Reconstruct contentPage before interpreting placeholder fields. Bind each full canonical JSON version to kind/id/actual team/part/normalized selector/source/format, validate every continuation and current requester, and preserve fixed logical comment/board pagination. Captured evidence replays exact selector-bound pages offline. Resource summaries retain original identity when capture budget ends before metadata is complete. Existing total storage/call/retention budgets are unchanged: keep captured prefixes explicitly incomplete and never advertise uncaptured bytes as complete. This extension requires actual producer HTTP/PG/evidence plus CP/CLI integration before full-read acceptance.
policy.click_snapshot_body: RIID-5892/5900: click-time HTML selects mentions; an authorized producer may return its persisted root document with unchanged source/version and authenticated server continuation. Supplying an editor snapshot does not require a client_snapshot response. Legacy client_snapshot responses remain bound to the exact input version and prefix and continue locally. Identity, permission, page and version validation remain required.
policy.human_comment_followup: RIID-5892: a new human execution preserves revalidated server-owned original comment evidence while resetting automatic depth/budget/ancestors. Immutable evidence Agent identity is independent of the new chain. Older missing bindings follow persisted same-task/root parent edges only; another requester cannot inherit the original capability. Active execution/tool approval does not reset limits. Fresh authorized follow-up snapshots are inherited by children. Human follow-up status targets its new message, with ordinary user notifications; automatic children target the calling Agent message.

limits: does not guarantee model comprehension or semantic completion
external attachment and linked URL bodies are not fetched by the server

loop.observation: Assignments carried parent titles and one previous message but not bounded parent documents or conversation evidence.
loop.hypothesis: Readable, scoped, bounded context can preserve the task goal while keeping the latest user directive authoritative.
loop.execute: Run synthetic task-context, permission/deadline, conversation-isolation and provider-placement regressions; verify this direct SSOT through knowledgecoverage in CI.
loop.evaluate: Test success, context budgets, resource metadata-only semantics, authorization identity and generated knowledge coverage must pass; live model comprehension is not inferred.
loop.retrospective: Keep inaccessible/truncated inputs explicit and preserve native session/workspace authority; expand context only from authorized references.

execution_status_boundary.persistence: assignment event projection stores bounded context per assignment/thread; cold history and SSE preserve it
execution_status_boundary.privacy: no absolute path/verification argv or credentials in execution_context
execution_status_boundary.legacy: missing context is unknown; never infer passed verification or permit replay
